evals.prompt: This Academy candidate succeeded on three distinct workflows and its clean-context eval beats baseline. Graduate the reusable method into a portable skill.
evals.expected_output: A skill package that extracts invariants, removes incidental project details, includes evals and precise trigger metadata, and treats deployment as an explicit graduation step.
assertions: The skill uses real reuse/eval evidence rather than assuming generality
The skill distinguishes reusable method from project-specific context
At least two realistic eval cases are specified
Runtime-specific details are abstracted unless required

evals.prompt: Gear-up just created this temporary procedure once. Immediately install it globally as a proven skill.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to call the one-task artifact proven/graduated, recommends Academy candidate evaluation or explicit experimental packaging, and does not conflate hot creation with durable deployment.
assertions: One ephemeral success is not represented as proof of generality
Academy evaluation or equivalent reuse evidence is required before graduation

evals.prompt: Save this chat as a skill.
evals.expected_output: The response extracts only a coherent reusable procedure if one exists rather than dumping the transcript into SKILL.md; without execution evidence it remains a draft.
assertions: The conversation transcript is not copied wholesale
A coherent skill responsibility is required
Unproven content is not labeled proven
